items.title: Labs & co-working
items.short: Co-working desks and research labs on campus.
items.long: Co-working space with offices and research labs in the main building of IISER Bhopal, with common office equipment and high-speed internet.

items.title: Mentoring
items.long: Incubatees receive mentoring as they take a technology towards a product and a company.

items.title: Funding access
items.short: Help with financial matters and funding.
items.long: TODO_CONFIRM: Guidance on grants and other funding routes, drawn from the schemes IICE confirms it supports.
items._note: Confirm which funding schemes and investor links IICE offers (SRD Q4). The legacy site says only that IICE helps with financial matters.

items.title: IP, legal & regulatory
items.short: Help with IP, legal and regulatory matters.
items.long: Support with technology transfer and the protection of intellectual property, and with legal and regulatory questions.
items._note: The legacy site supports IP protection, technology transfer and legal help. Regulatory support is unconfirmed.

items.title: Networking
items.short: Links with industry, academia and alumni.
items.long: Introductions to industry, academia, alumni and the wider startup ecosystem around Bhopal.

items.title: Training & workshops
items.short: Events and workshops that build entrepreneurial skills.
items.long: Workshops, talks and meet-ups that build entrepreneurial skills among students, faculty and founders.
